# Reference faces

Both JPGs are 256×256 crops of NASA's portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins, a work of the US
government in the public domain (NASA Great Images, https://flic.kr/p/r9qvLn), as shipped in
scikit-image 0.26 as `skimage/data/astronaut.png`.

- `eyes-open.jpg`: the crop, unchanged.
- `eyes-closed.jpg`: the same crop with both eyes painted over with eyelid skin tone and a lash
  line, so Apple Vision's eye landmarks close.
